name: A Place to Grow
source:
You found a job listing online for a manual labour job in a remote town, room and board included. 

The town is smaller than you expected. Only a few residents, no internet access and most local businesses completely boarded up. 

But who knows, maybe you could really grow some roots here.

[From [url=https://adoxographist.itch.io/a-place-to-grow]itch.io[/url]]
